WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

3. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.

4. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. When learning Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
